verdict.rationale: Meta publishes the canonical llama-models GitHub repo and downloadable open weights, so the artifacts can be inspected. However, they ship under the Llama Community License, which the vendor's own repo frames as 'principles of openness' rather than an OSI license, and which carries a documented 700M-MAU special-license restriction. Weight access is gated behind accepting terms and approval. missing for 10: an OSI-approved open license, ungated access to the weights, an explicit license for the repo's source code, and full training/data source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: The model weights are licensed for researchers and commercial entities, upholding the principles of openness
In this organization, you can find models in both the original Meta format as well as the Hugging Face transformers format.
if a licensee has over 700 million MAU they must request a special license from Meta
